designationHistory.indexText: The Fish and Wildlife Service approved establishment of Caddo Lake National Wildlife Refuge on part of the former Longhorn Army Ammunition Plant in Harrison County, Texas.

authority.citation: Service approval; land transferred from the U.S. Army

designationHistory.note: Both give October 19, 2000. Land has been conveyed from the Army in stages as cleanup is completed; the refuge opened to the public September 26, 2009 (Caddo Lake Institute). See also the October 19, 2000 Federal Register notices.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Caddo Lake NWR 'About Us' page
